Roster precedent, established with Ellis Cooper (DDL-4008): schema in the
Three rule kinds, and they are MEANT to overlap. Redundant coverage is
the design -- a directory caught by both its absolute path and its name
stays excluded after someone moves or copies it.
_exclude_paths_doc: Absolute paths. Matches the path itself and everything beneath it. Case-insensitive.
_exclude_dir_names_doc: Bare directory NAMES, matched at any depth. No separators -- the loader rejects entries that look like paths. This is the rule kind that survives a relocation.
_exclude_filename_patterns_doc: Globs matched against the basename only, e.g. '*.mbox', '*.har', '.env'. Case-insensitive.
